source_row.rationale: Rapid Response Teams are designed to bring critical care expertise to the bedside early, in response to subtle but concerning signs of clinical deterioration (before a full cardiac or respiratory arrest occurs), with the goal of intervening early enough to potentially prevent progression to a more severe event, and any staff member (including nurses on general medical-surgical units) should feel empowered to activate the team when concerned.
source_row.source_detail: Early Activation to Prevent Clinical Deterioration
source_row.source_name: IHI — Rapid Response Team Implementation and Purpose
source_row.stem: A nurse notices subtle but concerning changes in a client's condition that do not yet meet criteria for a full code but raise concern for clinical deterioration, and activates the hospital's Rapid Response Team, though a colleague questions why this was called before things got more serious.
